regionSource.capacityDefinition: Facility power GW, derived from European total minus Germany minus Central Europe (?)
regionSource.comments: Derived from European totals minus Germany and Central Europe. S&P Global reports Europe total at 18.7 GW (end 2024, including Germany/CE), growing to 36 GW by 2030. IEA projects +70% installed capacity by 2030 vs 2024. Mid forecast assumes Western Europe (UK, Ireland, France, Netherlands, Nordics, Benelux, Switzerland) at ~10 GW in 2025, growing to ~21 GW by 2030. High forecast reflects EU AI Continent Action Plan target of tripling capacity and faster Nordic expansion (110% demand growth by 2030 per DCD). Key sub-markets: UK (2.6 GW in 2025, up to 4.75 GW by 2030), France (1.72 GW), Nordics (projected >2.8 GW by 2030). Grid moratoriums in FLAP hubs (7-13 year wait) redirect growth to Nordics and southern Europe.
